subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard adopt a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed completion lifecycle as the review-gate contract?
rationale: The branch adds a new stored status and changes completion behavior for existing Workboard users; automation can identify the compatibility risk but cannot choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Repair and prove the new lifecycle
options.body: Keep the new direction only if the PR preserves existing contracts, updates all status/tool declarations and consumers, and adds upgrade plus real-behavior proof.

options.title: Avoid the durable status
options.body: Redesign the review gate around existing statuses if maintainers do not want another persisted Workboard lifecycle state.

options.title: Accept the fail-closed change as-is directionally
options.body: Maintainers may choose the stricter lifecycle, but should still require the concrete blockers and proof to be fixed before merge.

recommendation.title: Repair and prove the new lifecycle
recommendation.body: Keep the new direction only if the PR preserves existing contracts, updates all status/tool declarations and consumers, and adds upgrade plus real-behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` introduced the Workboard coordination and metadata surfaces that define this lifecycle contract.
